info.title: Scrapling x402 Data Store
info.description: Pay-per-call crypto prices, DeFi yields and TVL, Polymarket odds, Base token scam checks, stock/ETF snapshots and web-page scraping. Free endpoints under /v1/free; single lookups $0.002-$0.005 (live cache refreshed about every 30 min, typical response under 100 ms); scrapes $0.001-$0.025 per page; full datasets $0.01-$4.99. Paid in USDC via x402 v2 on Solana, Base, Polygon or Arbitrum; no account needed. Payments settle to 0x72C80C01fD89Bac74f47cf604b61ACd119c9BCdb.
info.x-guidance: Pay per call with x402 v2 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum). An unpaid call to a paid route returns without payment a 402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) with the amount and payTo; a retry carrying the payment proof returns the data. POST /v1/scrape {"url": ...} scrapes a page into Markdown, JSON-LD and tables; POST /v1/batch-scrape takes up to 100 urls; GET /v1/datasets lists datasets (free previews of up to 10 rows at /v1/datasets/{id}/preview) and GET /v1/datasets/{id}/buy?format=json buys one. FREE: /v1/free/feeds, /v1/free/crypto/top10, /v1/free/defi/top-yields. Single lookups: /v1/lookup/coin?q= $0.002, /v1/lookup/protocol?q= $0.002, /v1/lookup/yields?chain=&token= $0.003, /v1/lookup/pool?pool_id= $0.003, /v1/lookup/polymarket?q= $0.003, /v1/lookup/token-risk?address= $0.005 Dataset listings (optional q, limit, offset, format=json|csv; catalog free at /v1/free/datasets): /v1/datasets/coingecko-markets $0.03, /v1/datasets/defillama-protocols $0.02, /v1/datasets/volume-leaders $0.01 (live), /v1/datasets/market-heatmap $0.02 (live), /v1/datasets/dex-volume $0.02 (live). (misses return 404, no charge). Prices: scrape $0.001-$0.025 per page ($0.005 typical); datasets $0.01 (up to 10 rows), $0.05 (up to 100), $0.49 (up to 1,000), $1.99 (up to 10,000), max $4.99.
